title: Rockwell Automation ThinManager ThinServer Unrestricted File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Rockwell Automation ThinManager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ThinServer service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
